meaning:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.10.16; also called Shophach (NIV: Shophak) at 1Ch.19.16,18;
Another name of sho.vakh (שׁוֹבַךְ "Shobach" H7731)
§ Shophach = "expansion"
1) the general of Hadarezer
1a) also 'Shobach'

elsewhere.note: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers, and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain…
